name: focus_rubin_find
description: Fly the camera to one Rubin Observatory find and open its card. Accepts a designation ("2025 MN45"), a name ("3I/ATLAS"), or a nickname or description ("the speedy spinner", "Earth's quasi-moon", "Rubin's comet", "the long-distance traveler"). Orrery only. Returns the card text to talk about; if nothing matches, it returns the list of available finds.

name.description: Designation, name, or nickname of the find the child asked about.

view.description: close (default) flies up to the rock; orbit shows its whole path around the Sun.
